prompts.developer-walk:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite atlas for a premium hand-painted 2D side-scrolling fantasy beat-em-up called NULLPOINT. A NEW protagonist: an ordinary stocky 35-year-old male software developer with an unmistakably big rounded belly under a charcoal gray T-shirt, open dark teal zip hoodie (NO cloak), short messy dark brown hair, rectangular black glasses, short brown stubble, dark slate jogger trousers, worn off-white sneakers with teal accents. Warm pale skin. Same recognizable face, height, proportions, outfit and keyboard in every frame. He fights using a broad full-size dark mechanical COMPUTER KEYBOARD with many individual pale keycaps and subtle mint RGB light, carried firmly with both hands. The keyboard is a chunky rectangular peripheral about shoulder width; no blades or swords. Rich painted cloth folds, skin shading, clear confident silhouettes, soft teal rim light, warm highlights, expressive determined slightly tired face. Stylish detailed 2D painted sprites, not pixel art, not 3D, not a flat icon. Orthographic side view facing RIGHT, tiny three-quarter torso turn so the belly and glasses are clearly readable. Landscape 1536x1024 sprite sheet, EXACTLY EIGHT full-body poses in a strict uniform 4 columns by 2 rows grid, each 384x512 cell. Entire body, feet, hands and keyboard inside each cell with at least 22 pixels of padding. Constant character scale, standing height about 365 pixels, head height about 65 pixels. Place pelvis centered at local x=176, neutral standing foot baseline y=450. No inter-cell overlap. TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA background everywhere outside characters. No drawn checkerboard, no ground, no shadow underneath, no labels, no grid, no text, no duplicated people within a cell. CRITICAL ANIMATION REQUEST: Eight mechanically correct successive frames of ONE COMPLETE WALK CYCLE. This must be an animation-ready walk cycle, not eight illustrations of the same stance. The legs must actually pass underneath the hips and exchange front/back positions. Head and torso can stay identical. NO repeated static splayed legs.
Use this exact animation chart in order left to right, upper then lower row. CAMERA faces character's right side. NEAR leg = RIGHT leg with slightly lighter denim shading, FAR leg = LEFT leg with darker shading.
0 CONTACT: near/right foot at local x=290 flat on baseline, far/left toe at x=95 on baseline, legs wide apart.
1 DOWN: near/right planted foot at x=240, near knee bent taking weight; far/left foot x=125 raised 35 px behind, far knee bent.
2 PASSING: near/right planted foot DIRECTLY UNDER hip at x=190, right leg nearly vertical; far/left KNEE is moving forward in front of hip and far/left FOOT raised at x=185,y=385. Feet horizontally CLOSE TOGETHER, NOT spread apart. Important passing pose.
3 UP: near/right planted toe x=135 behind hip, right leg slants BACKWARDS; far/left leg reaches forward with foot x=245,y=430.
4 OPPOSITE CONTACT: near/right toe at x=95 behind, far/left heel at x=290 forward on baseline. Near right leg angles BACK, not forwards. This is reverse leg arrangement of frame 0.
5 DOWN: far/left planted foot x=240, far knee taking weight; near/right foot x=125 raised behind, near knee bent.
6 OPPOSITE PASSING: far/left planted foot DIRECTLY UNDER hip at x=190, left leg nearly vertical; near/right KNEE moving forward in front of hip and near/right FOOT raised at x=185,y=385. Feet horizontally CLOSE TOGETHER. Again a clear single support passing pose, not wide splayed stance.
7 UP: far/left planted toe x=135 behind hip; near/right leg reaches forward, foot x=245,y=430, approaching frame 0.
Standing planted soles baseline y=480 for all cells. Stable pelvis at x=190,y=300, stable head centered x=225,y=60. Body standing height about 465px, consistent with the original character size. Slight 5px vertical body weight shift allowed. Alternating feet travel from IN FRONT OF body, directly UNDER body, then BEHIND body during each stance. No running, no both-feet-airborne, no body translation across cells, no duplicated first half in second half. Hold keyboard steadily in BOTH hands across belly; identical face, hoodie and belly in every frame. Actual transparent alpha background.
